items.t: Stem to Deploy Integrated PowerTrack™ Software and Power Plant Controls for the First Utility-Scale Solar Project in The Republic of Georgia
items.sum: HOUSTON, November 12, 2026--Stem, Inc. (NYSE: STEM), a global leader in AI-enabled clean energy software and services, today announced that Voltares, an international renewable energy developer and investor, has selected Stem to deliver its integrated PowerTrack™ software and power plant controls for Marneuli-I, a 68 MW solar facility in the Republic of Georgia.
